# Automation blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Automation blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## queue

Typed jobs on Supabase Queues (pgmq) or a plain table (blocks.queue.options.backend): leases, retries with backoff, dead letters, deduplication keys, queue stats, and schedules with pg_cron or the drain route.

- Title: Job queue
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue
- Client: `queueBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/queue`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `housekeeping`
- Works with: `data-lifecycle`
- Env keys: `CRON_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

## idempotency

Stores responses by Idempotency-Key so retried requests replay the first result instead of running twice.

- Title: Idempotency keys
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `housekeeping`
- Works with: `housekeeping`

## webhook-inbox

Stores verified webhooks once per message id, per tenant when given, then processes them with leases, retries and checkpoints, in its own table or one of the app's.

- Title: Webhook inbox
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `housekeeping`
- Works with: `data-lifecycle`, `housekeeping`

## rate-limit

Fixed-window limits on Data API writes (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE) per user or claim, checked by pgrst.db_pre_request. Over the limit: 429 with Retry-After.

- Title: Write rate limits
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `housekeeping`
- Works with: `housekeeping`

## outbox

Events written in the same transaction as the change, read by named consumers with their own cursor and lease, kept for history and relayed as CloudEvents.

- Title: Outbox
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox
- Client: `outboxBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/outbox`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Works with: `data-lifecycle`
- Env keys: `CRON_SECRET`, `APP_URL`

## streams

Ordered text chunks a writer appends and any reader resumes from an index: idempotent batches, a cancel flag the writer reads on its next append, owner reads through RLS, a payload-free Realtime ping on a private topic per stream, and a purge for expired streams.

- Title: Durable streams
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/streams
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`

## workflows

Engine-neutral workflow runs that members read through RLS, with a Realtime ping per status change and workflow_run.completed, .failed and .cancelled outbox events; cron schedules with idempotent fires, counting semaphores, admission control for starts (concurrency, debounce, singleton) and a retention purge.

- Title: Workflows
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/workflows
- Client: `workflowsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/workflows`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `data-lifecycle`
- Events (`WorkflowsEvents`): `workflow_run.cancelled`, `workflow_run.completed`, `workflow_run.failed`
- Provides: `workflows`

## workflow-sdk

The tables of the Workflow SDK World (@workflow/world-postgres 5.2.0) in the workflow schema, closed to the API roles; a trigger that copies each run into workflow_runs, a pg_net dispatcher for the delivery queue on a pg_cron schedule, start idempotency keys, a list of the hooks open runs wait on and a purge of ended runs.

- Title: Workflow SDK World
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/workflow-sdk
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `workflows`, `queue`, `permissions`

## workflow-editor

Workflow definitions a tenant edits as an engine-neutral node graph, with draft, published and archived versions, triggers (webhook tokens stored hashed), credential references a CredentialProvider resolves, a synced step library, per-node run status pinged on the run's topic, and failed and slow alerts written as workflow_alert.triggered outbox events.

- Title: Workflow builder
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/workflow-editor
- Client: `workflowEditorBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/workflow-editor`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `workflows`, `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `service-accounts`, `subjects`, `teams`
- Entities: `workflow_definition`
- Tables: `workflow_definitions`
- Permission keys: `workflow_editor.read`, `workflow_editor.run`, `workflow_editor.write`, `workflow_editor.publish`, `workflow_editor.manage`
- Events (`WorkflowEditorEvents`): `workflow_alert.triggered`, `workflow_definition.published`
- Consumes: `workflows (optional)`

## connectors

MCP servers per tenant with no, per-user OAuth or header auth; per-user grants that hold only a credential_ref; MCP sessions per chat; and tool list fingerprints that hold a changed list until an admin approves it.

- Title: Connectors
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/connectors
- Client: `connectorsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/connectors`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Entities: `connector_server`
- Tables: `connector_servers`
- Permission keys: `connectors.read`, `connectors.use`, `connectors.manage`
- Events (`ConnectorsEvents`): `connector.created`, `connector.deleted`, `connector.fingerprint_decided`, `connector.updated`, `connector_grant.created`, `connector_grant.revoked`

## automations

Tenant-editable automations: a filter tree over a subject type's field catalog, tested when a trigger event happens, with action references the action registry runs. Blocks ship default automations (rule_defaults) that every organization gets a copy of, may turn off or edit, and can reset. rule_matches() evaluates a tree in SQL the same way evaluateFilterQuery does in TypeScript.

- Title: Rules
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/automations
- Client: `automationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/automations`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Entities: `automation`
- Tables: `automations`
- Permission keys: `automations.read`, `automations.write`, `automations.publish`, `automations.manage`
- Events (`AutomationsEvents`): `automation.created`, `automation.deleted`, `automation.disabled`, `automation.enabled`, `automation.matched`, `automation.updated`
- Actions: `approvals.request`, `notify`, `set_field`, `webhook`, `workflow`

## housekeeping

One dispatcher for the recurring cleanups the installed blocks contribute (purges, expiries): maintenance() runs each due job and records its outcome, and maintenance_schedule() registers it with pg_cron.

- Title: Housekeeping
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sql
- Modes: `managed`
